data.exact_reserve_text: Change in provision for 2013 claims: (519) (GBP 000) Gross from page 30. From the Gross claims development triangle on page 18, the 2014 YOA current estimate (After three years) of 45,462 (GBP 000) compared to its previous diagonal (After two years) of 22,837 (GBP 000) shows a strengthening of 22,625 (GBP 000).
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a significant gross reserve strengthening of GBP 23.144 million in 2016, primarily affecting the 2013 and 2014 underwriting years. This adverse development is attributed to slower than expected claims development in the early years, the disproportionate impact of early large losses on a small premium base, and adverse results from the Irish Republic due to the difficult legal environment. Regulatory changes also contributed to the challenging environment.
raw_causal_phrases: slower but growing development of the account
impact of a number of early losses had a disproportionate impact on a small premium base
adverse results emanating from the Irish Republic due to the difficult legal environment
changes in regulatory requirements from the European Union, the Prudential Regulation Authority, the Financial Conduct Authority and Lloyd's

data.data_quality_notes: The gross prior year development is calculated by combining an explicit gross strengthening for the 2013 YOA from a movement note on page 30, and a calculated gross strengthening for the 2014 YOA from the gross claims development triangle on page 18.
